original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-pullback-cotangent-morphism-topoi}
Let $f : \Sh(\mathcal{D}) \to \Sh(\mathcal{C})$ be a morphism of topoi.
Let $\mathcal{A} \to \mathcal{B}$ be a homomorphism of sheaves of rings
on $\mathcal{C}$. Then
$f^{-1}L_{\mathcal{B}/\mathcal{A}} = L_{f^{-1}\mathcal{B}/f^{-1}\mathcal{A}}$.

final_content.statement:
For a site $\mathcal S$ and a homomorphism of sheaves of commutative rings $\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$, form the standard augmented simplicial polynomial $\mathcal A$-algebra resolution $\mathcal P_\bullet\to\mathcal B$, with $\mathcal P_0=\mathcal A[\mathcal B]$, $\mathcal P_1=\mathcal A[\mathcal A[\mathcal B]]$, and so on. Its normalized complex of $\mathcal B$-modules $\Omega_{\mathcal P_\bullet/\mathcal A}\otimes_{\mathcal P_\bullet}\mathcal B$, in nonpositive degrees, is the cotangent complex $L_{\mathcal B/\mathcal A}\in D(\mathcal B)$, and $\Omega_{\mathcal B/\mathcal A}$ is the sheaf of Kähler differentials. The map $L$ is functorial in squares of ring-sheaf homomorphisms.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-triangle-sheaves-rings}
Let $\mathcal{D}$ be a site. Let $\mathcal{A} \to \mathcal{B} \to \mathcal{C}$
be homomorphisms of sheaves of rings on $\mathcal{D}$.
There is a canonical distinguished triangle
$$
L_{\mathcal{B}/\mathcal{A}} \otimes_\mathcal{B}^\mathbf{L} \mathcal{C}
\to L_{\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{A}} \to L_{\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{B}} \to
L_{\mathcal{B}/\mathcal{A}} \otimes_\mathcal{B}^\mathbf{L} \mathcal{C}[1]
$$
in $D(\mathcal{C})$.

The map $L$ is functorial in squares of ring-sheaf homomorphisms.
